answers.genPolicy:df0871034bf3d1fd055c65522c54ab:
[B1] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'approach' Device
=> < UserX | 'near' : Device , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'near' : Device , ... > $ UserX 'leave' Device
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
[B3] < Cloud | 'cloudKey' : 'secret' , Device : ('trusted' : (UserX) , ...) , ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : Device , ... > $ UserX 'shareAccess' Cloud | (Device ; UserY)
=> < Cloud | 'cloudKey' : 'secret' , Device : ('trusted' : (UserX , UserY) , ...) , ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : Device , ... > $ Cloud 'deliverCommand' RelayUser | (Device ; encrypt('auth','secret') ; 'share' ; UserY) .
[B4] < Cloud | 'cloudKey' : 'secret' , Device : ('trusted' : (UserX , UserY) , ...) , ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : Device , ... > $ UserX 'revokeAccess' Cloud | (Device ; UserY)
=> < Cloud | 'cloudKey' : 'secret' , Device : ('trusted' : (UserX) , ...) , ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : Device , ... > $ Cloud 'deliverCommand' RelayUser | (Device ; encrypt('auth','secret') ; 'revoke' ; UserY) .
[B5] < RelayUser | 'near' : Device , ... > < Device | ... > $ RelayUser 'forwardCommand' Device | (L)
=> < RelayUser | 'near' : Device , ... > < Device | ... > $ RelayUser 'proxy' Device | (L) .
[B6] < CachingRelayUser | 'near' : Device , 'cachedCommand' : nils , ... > $ Cloud 'deliverCommand' CachingRelayUser | (Device ; Command)
=> < CachingRelayUser | 'near' : Device , 'cachedCommand' : Command , ... > .
[B7] < CachingRelayUser | 'near' : Device , 'cachedCommand' : L , ... > < Device | ... > $ CachingRelayUser 'forwardCommand' Device | (L)
=> < CachingRelayUser | 'near' : Device , 'cachedCommand' : nils , ... > < Device | ... > $ CachingRelayUser 'proxy' Device | (L) .
[B8] < Device | 'trusted' : Users , ... > $ RelayUser 'proxy' Device | (encrypt('auth','secret') ; 'share' ; UserY)
=> < Device | 'trusted' : (Users , UserY) , ... > .
[B9] < Device | 'trusted' : (Users , UserY) , ... > $ RelayUser 'proxy' Device | (encrypt('auth','secret') ; 'revoke' ; UserY)
=> < Device | 'trusted' : Users , ... > .
